description: Resolve a Lightning Address (user@domain.com) to a payable BOLT11 invoice for a given amount. Handles the full LNURL-pay protocol internally. Returns the invoice plus min/max sendable amounts for validation. Price: 10 sats per call.

amount_sats.description: Amount you want to send, in satoshis. At most 100000000 (1 BTC).

l402_proof.description: L402 payment proof "<macaroon>:<preimage>". Omit on the first call; an unpaid call returns a 10 sat Lightning invoice and the macaroon. Pay the invoice, then repeat the call with this argument set.

name: lightning_address_resolve
